mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_groups (group_name, group_avatar, owner_id, group_type, is_public, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{groupName}, #{groupAvatar}, #{ownerId}, #{groupType}, #{isPublic}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT group_id, group_name, group_avatar, owner_id, group_type, is_public, created_at, updated_at FROM chat_groups WHERE group_id = #{groupId} LIMIT 1

SELECT cg.group_id, cg.group_name, cg.group_avatar, cg.owner_id, cg.group_type, cg.is_public, cg.created_at, cg.updated_at, COUNT(gm.user_id) AS member_count, u.username AS owner_name FROM chat_groups cg JOIN users u ON cg.owner_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN group_members gm ON cg.group_id = gm.group_id WHERE cg.group_id = #{groupId} GROUP BY cg.group_id, cg.group_name, cg.group_avatar, cg.owner_id, cg.group_type, cg.is_public, cg.created_at, cg.updated_at, u.username LIMIT 1

SELECT cg.group_id, cg.group_name, cg.group_avatar, cg.owner_id, cg.group_type, cg.is_public, cg.created_at, cg.updated_at, COUNT(gm.user_id) AS member_count, u.username AS owner_name FROM chat_groups cg JOIN group_members gm ON cg.group_id = gm.group_id JOIN users u ON cg.owner_id = u.user_id WHERE gm.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY cg.group_id, cg.group_name, cg.group_avatar, cg.owner_id, cg.group_type, cg.is_public, cg.created_at, cg.updated_at, u.username ORDER BY cg.updated_at DESC

SELECT cg.group_id, cg.group_name, cg.group_avatar, cg.owner_id, cg.group_type, cg.is_public, cg.created_at, cg.updated_at, COUNT(gm2.user_id) AS member_count, u.username AS owner_name FROM chat_groups cg JOIN users u ON cg.owner_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN group_members gm2 ON cg.group_id = gm2.group_id WHERE cg.group_id NOT IN ( SELECT gm.group_id FROM group_members gm WHERE gm.user_id = #{userId} ) AND (lower(cg.group_name) LIKE lower(concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')) OR cast(cg.group_id AS text) LIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')) GROUP BY cg.group_id, cg.group_name, cg.group_avatar, cg.owner_id, cg.group_type, cg.is_public, cg.created_at, cg.updated_at, u.username ORDER BY CASE WHEN lower(cg.group_name) = lower(#{keyword}) THEN 3 WHEN lower(cg.group_name) LIKE lower(concat(#{keyword}, '%')) THEN 2 WHEN cast(cg.group_id AS text) = #{keyword} THEN 2 ELSE 1 END DESC, cg.created_at DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT cg.group_id, cg.group_name, cg.group_avatar, cg.owner_id, cg.group_type, cg.is_public, cg.created_at, cg.updated_at, COUNT(gm2.user_id) AS member_count, u.username AS owner_name FROM chat_groups cg JOIN users u ON cg.owner_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN group_members gm2 ON cg.group_id = gm2.group_id WHERE cg.is_public = 1 AND cg.group_id NOT IN ( SELECT gm.group_id FROM group_members gm WHERE gm.user_id = #{userId} ) GROUP BY cg.group_id, cg.group_name, cg.group_avatar, cg.owner_id, cg.group_type, cg.is_public, cg.created_at, cg.updated_at, u.username ORDER BY cg.created_at DESC

mapper.delete: DELETE FROM group_members WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND user_id = #{userId}
